name: M20 Tws Wireless Earbuds
description:
M20 Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds TWS V5.3

Technical Details

Product type: Bluetooth earbuds
Bluetooth Version: 3.5A
Bluetooth Profiles: A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, HSP
Origin: China
Operating Voltage: 3.1V to 4.2V
Charging Voltage: 5V-1A
Speaker Units: Dual 8mm
Frequency Response: 20Hz to 20kHz
Impedance: 32Ω
Headset Battery Capacity: 50mAh
Charging Box Battery Capacity: 2000mAh
Transmission Distance: Greater than 10-20m
Call Playback Time: Approximately 4-6 hours
Headset Charging Time: 1.5 hours
Charging Box Charging Time: 2 hours
Standby: 280 hours
Packaging: Plastic Paper
Key Features
Utilizes Bluetooth 5.3 technology for rapid and stable signal transmission.
Boasts an IPX7 waterproof rating, rendering it suitable for sports and outdoor pursuits
Features dual 8mm speaker units, delivering exceptional stereo sound and robust bass.
Crafted with a lightweight, ergonomic design to ensure comfort and a secure fit.
Equipped with a charging case featuring a substantial 2000mAh battery capacity, ensuring prolonged usage and convenient on-the-go charging.
 Facilitates easy operation and access to various functions through a one-button control system.

If have any manufacturing defect then 7 days replacement Gurranty (If products have found any spot or damage then not returnable)
